items.source: Strategy interface for customizing JedisClientConfig. Objects implementing this interface will be invoked with any ClientConfig builder so you can customize the ClientConfig builder after Spring has applied its defaults.
items.translation: 用于自定义 `JedisClientConfig` 的策略接口。实现此接口的对象将被任何 `ClientConfig` 构建器调用，以便在 Spring 应用其默认值后对 `ClientConfig` 构建器进行自定义。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
